symptom: Retired text models stay enabled or are silently pruned with their user configuration.
direct_cause: The existing list probe only classifies vendor reachability; seed retirement deletes rows.
class_root: Catalog persistence lacks a reversible listing reconciliation boundary.
affected_population: Existing installations with seeded text models across vendors
entry_points: Vendor health on model settings open

external_sources.purpose: Minimum non-streaming request and choices response shape.

internal_only_reason: Product listing policy is specified by the approved stage 5b brief; the existing list parser owns HTTP protocol validation.
invariants: Only complete successful lists can mark seeded text models unlisted.
A restored listing never automatically enables a model.
Deleting a seeded model does not reseed it on refresh.
generality_proof: Vendor-scoped catalog mutations apply one policy to all seeded text models; failed/partial/stale results cannot mutate.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Derive reversible catalog changes from complete provider evidence.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: All credentialed health requests use the shared list primitive and catalog reconciliation.
Explicit retired-text migration retains rows, while suppression prevents deleted seeds returning.

recurrence.reason: Every provider can change its model list after installation.
same_class_scan: rg fetchModelList electron: onboarding discovery and vendor health independently checked.
rg RETIRED electron/catalog/seedBuiltins.ts: text pruning and seed insertion independently checked.

prevention.invariant: Full listing evidence changes availability reversibly within vendor scope.
prevention.failure_mode: No changes on incomplete, failed, unchanged or stale results.
prevention.strategy: Derive patches once and apply them atomically to the latest catalog state.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace automatic retired-text pruning with reversible migration; no file removal.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency change: reuse the existing HTTP list primitive and catalog mutation owner.

migration: Retired text ids on existing installs are disabled and retained; restored listings only clear unlisted.
residual_risks: Provider listing absence is not proof of paid generation failure; users may explicitly enable.
